2048. File Write Read and Character Count

70

Hard

Problem Statement
Write the given text to a file and then read it back from the same file using Java file I/O streams. After reading the content, print the content and the total number of characters read.
Description
Read a line of text from the user. Use FileWriter to write the text into a file named output.txt. Then use FileReader wrapped in BufferedReader to read the content back from the file. Print the content and the number of characters present in the original text.
input_spec: A single line containing a string, str.
output_spec:
.txt. Then use FileReader wrapped in BufferedReader to read the content back from the file. Print the content and the number of characters present in the original text.
Input Description
A single line containing a string, str.
Output Description
Print the content read from the file on the first line.
Print the total number of characters in the string on the second line in the format:
Character Count: X
